paragraphs.source_en: On the first day of the third month of Tenshō 18, Hideyoshi, proudly bearing the sword of command, crossed the three newly built bridges and set out eastward; the news swiftly spread along the Tōkaidō. Hideyoshi's expedition this time was even more imposing than his previous Kyushu campaign, astonishing even the worldly people of Kyoto.
